group_rule: Filename timestamp chronological gap >300 seconds or backward reset. Defined WITHOUT UV labels. Leave one entire proxy group out.
objective: Lexicographic minimize calibration FP, then maximize calibration TP, then first deterministic grid index. No heldout labels in select().
exposure: All 1528 previously inspected; internal exploratory diagnosis, NOT independent test. Group proxy not certified scenes.
BPA: Positive-only: mF=(1-u0)*r*c; mN=0; mU=1-mF. Raw c not calibrated probability. DS normalized combination K=0. Thermal reliability optionally rT*clip(IoU/.3,0,1); RGB remains asymmetric strong reference. Both REAL detector boxes and IoU>=gate mandatory; missing consensus binary0 with mass ignorance.
decision: max selected matched mF > threshold (strict); dummy Hungarian maximum total eligible IoU, one-to-one.

geometry.direction: thermal pts2 -> RGB pts1 original pixel coordinates
geometry.estimator: cv2.estimateAffine2D FULL affine RANSAC; seed=7; threshold=3px; maxIters=2000; confidence=0.99; refineIters=10
geometry.note: Seven points occupy narrow y band; fitting and LOO do not validate independent scenes, field coverage or parallax. No manual offsets or projective mapping.
